title: H4 fix round 5: executor.start's finally must not release the reservation when the fallback branch hands the task to a background run_worker thread; ownership passes to that thread, which releases at its end (review T-0402)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain ade6b74, 530c2ab, c1ba47c, aca3bb2, d54104f and a214aaf (T-0362, T-0392, T-0395, T-0398, T-0400) in git log; never drop or amend them.
Review T-0402 on T-0400, one high finding:
1. orchestrator/executor.py:178 start()'s finally releases the reservation unconditionally, including on _exhausted()'s fallback branch, which only starts a background thread (run_worker(task_id, account_id=...)) and returns; the reservation is released the instant start() returns, before the thread's own reserve, so the primary Codex-cooling path runs with no reservation counted. Fix: make reservation ownership explicit: start() releases in finally only when it ran the work itself (Codex path) or exited without handing off (refused, held, exception); on the fallback hand-off it transfers ownership by leaving the reservation in place (or re-keying it to the worker's run key) and run_worker releases at its end in its own finally, reusing the existing reservation instead of creating a second one. Test: tests/test_executor.py::test_fallback_handoff_keeps_reservation_until_worker_finishes (Codex cooling, start() returns after spawning the worker thread, the reservation still exists until the mocked run_worker completes, then it is released exactly once) and tests/test_executor.py::test_refused_or_exception_path_releases_immediately.
Keep every T-0362 lineage test green (test_exhausted_hold_releases_dispatch_reservation, test_reservation_owner_matches_running_executor, test_failed_dispatch_stamp_releases_reservation, test_fallback_claude_when_codex_cooling, and the pool and daemon reservation tests). Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh from the worktree root until it exits 0, then git add -A and git commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows a214aaf, d54104f, aca3bb2, c1ba47c, 530c2ab and ade6b74 below your commit
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
